name: Cherep lycarja Govarda
source:
Today you are a guest. So forget all your problems, take a sip of hot tea and listen to the story of an artifact that, according to legends, can manipulate time...

[Translated from [url=https://unknown-thief.itch.io/unknown-skull]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天你是一位客人。所以忘记所有的问题，喝一口热茶，听听传说中可以操纵时间的神器的故事……

[译自[url=https://unknown-thief.itch.io/unknown-skull]itch.io[/url]]
